metadata.name: My Stuff Descriptions for REPENTOGON
metadata.description:
[h1] My Stuff Descriptions for REPENTOGON [/h1]
Adds item descriptions and item inspection controls to the [b] My Stuff [/b] section of the pause menu in [i] The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ [/i].
The mod supports collectibles, smelted trinkets, modded collectibles, and modded trinkets. It also supports viewing items from multiple in-game characters, including local co-op players and multi-character setups.
The My Stuff display can automatically adapt to the layout of other custom pause-menu mods, allowing item icons and related UI elements to follow repositioned or resized My Stuff pages.
The mod is designed for the REPENTOGON-compatible game version and uses [b] External Item Descriptions (EID) [/b] to provide item information.
[h2] Dependencies [/h2]
This mod requires: [list] [*] [b] REPENTOGON [/b] [*] [b] External Item Descriptions (EID) [/b] [/list]
At the moment, REPENTOGON supports patch [b] v1.9.7.12 [/b] and automatically downgrades the game to that version when necessary.
Official Item Descriptions were introduced in [b] v1.9.7.13 [/b], which is newer than the version currently supported by REPENTOGON. As a result, this mod is primarily intended for the REPENTOGON-compatible [b] v1.9.7.12 [/b] environment, where the official item-description feature is not available.
[h2] Controls [/h2]
While the pause menu is open: [list] [*] Press [b] Left [/b] or [b] Right [/b] to enter [b] Inspect Mode [/b]. [*] Use the [b] Up, Down, Left, and Right [/b] directional controls to move the cursor between items. [*] When the cursor reaches the topmost or bottommost item, pressing [b] Up [/b] or [b] Down [/b] again switches to another character's item list, if available. [*] When the cursor reaches either horizontal edge of the item list, pressing [b] Left [/b] or [b] Right [/b] again in that direction exits Inspect Mode and returns control to the pause menu. [/list]
[h2] Configuration [/h2]
The mod provides additional options through Mod Config Menu:
[b] Appearance [/b] [list] [*] Adjust the brightness of item and trinket icons. [*] Enable and customize icon outlines for better visibility against different pause-menu backgrounds. [/list]
[b] Layout [/b] [list] [*] Adjust the rendering offset of the My Stuff display. [/list]
